- Long format XML: data is stored in rows where each row represents a single observation (e.g., multiple `<record>` elements each with a key, attribute name, and value)
- Wide format XML: data is stored where each attribute becomes its own element (e.g., a single `<record>` with many child elements)

"""Pivot XML data between long and wide formats."""

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from collections import defaultdict


def xml_long_to_wide(root, record_tag, key_elem, attr_elem, value_elem):
    """Convert XML from long format to wide format.

    Long format:
        <data>
            <record><id>1</id><attr>name</attr><value>Alice</value></record>
            <record><id>1</id><attr>age</attr><value>30</value></record>
            <record><id>2</id><attr>name</attr><value>Bob</value></record>
        </data>

    Wide format:
        <data>
            <record><id>1</id><name>Alice</name><age>30</age></record>
            <record><id>2</id><name>Bob</name></record>
        </data>

    Args:
        root: ElementTree root element (or Element) of the source XML.
        record_tag: Tag name of each record element (e.g. "record").
        key_elem: Tag whose text identifies which records belong together (e.g. "id").
        attr_elem: Tag whose text becomes the new element name (e.g. "attr").
        value_elem: Tag whose text becomes the new element value (e.g. "value").

    Returns:
        An ElementTree.Element representing the wide-format root.
    """
    groups = defaultdict(dict)
    record_attribs = {}
    record_children_extra = defaultdict(dict)

    for record in root.iter(record_tag):
        key = record.findtext(key_elem)
        attr = record.findtext(attr_elem)
        val = record.findtext(value_elem)

        if key is None or attr is None:
            continue

        groups[key][attr] = val or ""

        # Preserve attributes on the record element itself
        if key not in record_attribs:
            record_attribs[key] = record.attrib

        # Preserve any child elements that aren't key/attr/value
        for child in record:
            if child.tag not in (key_elem, attr_elem, value_elem):
                record_children_extra[key].setdefault(child.tag, child.text or "")

    wide_root = ET.Element(root.tag, root.attrib)

    for key, attrs in groups.items():
        rec = ET.SubElement(wide_root, record_tag, record_attribs.get(key, {}))

        # Put the key element first
        key_el = ET.SubElement(rec, key_elem)
        key_el.text = key

        # Preserve extra children
        for tag, text in record_children_extra.get(key, {}).items():
            el = ET.SubElement(rec, tag)
            el.text = text

        # Add the pivoted attributes as child elements
        for attr_name, attr_val in attrs.items():
            el = ET.SubElement(rec, attr_name)
            el.text = attr_val

    return wide_root


def xml_wide_to_long(root, record_tag, key_elem, attrs, value_tag=None):
    """Convert XML from wide format to long format.

    Wide format:
        <data>
            <record><id>1</id><name>Alice</name><age>30</age></record>
        </data>

    Long format (with value_tag="value", attr_tag="attr"):
        <data>
            <record><id>1</id><attr>name</attr><value>Alice</value></record>
            <record><id>1</id><attr>age</attr><value>30</value></record>
        </data>

    Args:
        root: ElementTree root element of the source XML.
        record_tag: Tag name of each record element.
        key_elem: Tag that identifies the record key (kept in output rows).
        attrs: List of tag names to unpivot into long rows.
        value_tag: Tag name for the value column. Defaults to "value".

    Returns:
        An ElementTree.Element representing the long-format root.
    """
    if value_tag is None:
        value_tag = "value"

    long_root = ET.Element(root.tag, root.attrib)

    for record in root.iter(record_tag):
        key_val = record.findtext(key_elem)

        for attr_name in attrs:
            attr_el = record.find(attr_name)
            if attr_el is None:
                continue

            new_rec = ET.SubElement(long_root, record_tag, record.attrib)

            key_el = ET.SubElement(new_rec, key_elem)
            key_el.text = key_val

            name_el = ET.SubElement(new_rec, "attr")
            name_el.text = attr_name

            val_el = ET.SubElement(new_rec, value_tag)
            val_el.text = attr_el.text or ""

    return long_root


def _indent(elem, level=0):
    """Add pretty-print indentation to an element tree."""
    indent_str = "\n" + "  " * level
    if len(elem):
        if not elem.text or not elem.text.strip():
            elem.text = indent_str + "  "
        if not elem.tail or not elem.tail.strip():
            elem.tail = indent_str
        for child in elem:
            _indent(child, level + 1)
        if not child.tail or not child.tail.strip():
            child.tail = indent_str
    else:
        if not elem.tail or not elem.tail.strip():
            elem.tail = indent_str
    if level == 0:
        elem.tail = "\n"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Demo / self-test
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if __name__ == "__main__":
    long_xml = """\
<data>
  <record>
    <id>1</id>
    <attr>name</attr>
    <value>Alice</value>
  </record>
  <record>
    <id>1</id>
    <attr>age</attr>
    <value>30</value>
  </record>
  <record>
    <id>2</id>
    <attr>name</attr>
    <value>Bob</value>
  </record>
  <record>
    <id>2</id>
    <attr>age</attr>
    <value>25</value>
  </record>
</data>
"""

    print("=== Long format (input) ===")
    print(long_xml)

    tree = ET.ElementTree(ET.fromstring(long_xml))
    wide_root = xml_long_to_wide(tree.getroot(), "record", "id", "attr", "value")
    _indent(wide_root)

    print("=== Wide format (after long→wide) ===")
    print(ET.tostring(wide_root, encoding="unicode"))

    long_again = xml_wide_to_long(wide_root, "record", "id", ["name", "age"])
    _indent(long_again)

    print("=== Long format (after wide→long round-trip) ===")
    print(ET.tostring(long_again, encoding="unicode"))

The file is at `xml_pivot.py`. It provides two functions that round-trip cleanly:

**`xml_long_to_wide`** — groups records by a key element and pivots attribute/value pairs into child elements:

```xml
<!-- Input (long): multiple records per id -->
<record><id>1</id><attr>name</attr><value>Alice</value></record>
<record><id>1</id><attr>age</attr><value>30</value></record>

<!-- Output (wide): one record per id, attributes become elements -->
<record><id>1</id><name>Alice</name><age>30</age></record>
```

**`xml_wide_to_long`** — unpivots named child elements back into key/attr/value rows:

```python
xml_wide_to_long(root, "record", "id", ["name", "age"])
```

Both preserve record-level attributes and any extra child elements that aren't part of the pivot. The `__main__` block demos the full round-trip (long → wide → long) which produces identical output.
